newsitem.title: USA: Liggett packs to have new warning.
newsitem.headline: Liggett packs to have new warning.

text.p: New warning labels are about to grace packs of cigarettes on brands produced by Liggett Group, the result of a landmark settlement by the tobacco company, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Thursday's electronic edition, the Journal said the label will read in small print: "Warning: Smoking is addictive."
The warning is to appear on Liggett brands, including Eve, L&M and Chesterfield. Liggett is a unit of Brooke Group Ltd.
The new label is expected to show up on packs that arrive in stores in the next week.
